blocks.text: SERIOUS THINGS OCCURRING -— There are tragedies of every kind you can think of on the earth and yet the people have not seen even an inch of it yet coming. The earth is becoming like hell itself! We’ve only seen a season of the cataclysms! But yet His elect will be surrounded with glory until they get at a certain presence and He’ll take them all away! It’s getting so bad that God’s people are going to be pushed right up into Heaven! The cycles I mentioned in different places, you can count on them occurring through the end of the decade.

SIGNED, SEALED AND DELIVERED— The U.S.A. is slowly but definitely turning into the dragon. In Rev. 13:11 it says, “And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.” The four elements, the heavens, earth, economics, and religion will quadruple in years 2009 — 2011. The numerical twelve will effect everything in heaven and earth. In the era we spoke about it will be the worst since crossing the century! In fact, as God gathers His final Elect, in this decade the people will think they’re on another planet after God shakes it! I foretold in 2009-11 the cycle of the sun and the elements, society, religion, weather, etc. will go through a tremendous shaking and change. The whole earth will have its worst wickedness and every sign of the age ending. I pray that the Elect will be taken out! It’s so awful. — In fact in the next three years there are going to be a lot of surprises and changes in every factor. Unexpected events are definitely foreshown in the Bible, celestial and scripts. We have already seen how they’ve found things in the Great Pyramid. It reveals the age is beginning to terminate towards the tribulation. In the year Sept. 2001 we know we saw the great horrific buildings go down. I knew the era they spoke about began.

Note: Because of the importance of this we’re going to redo the following script about the celestial. Science said the last eclipse (Oct. 2003) was the strangest in 100 years of their records. Plus the aurora lights were different too. What normally occurs in August occurred in November. And now we quote from Scroll #178. You can see for yourself what has happened since this script was written years ago in 1990. This prophecy was fulfilled and is still fulfilling with new things.

THE HEAVENS SPEAK PROPHETICALLY— “They are portraying a story. Unless we have the key it is like an unknown tongue to us!” (Ps. Chap 19) — “In different periods of the 90’s the planets and stars will show forth rare and unusual conjunctions, alignments, eclipses, etc. — The Lord revealed to me they are building up for some of the most unusual phenomena of this century! — As they forecast shadows of things to come! — Most are omens of calamities! — I wish it could be said otherwise, but can’t.

But neither do the Scriptures end the age with all good things! — “Except for the elect, they are rejoicing knowing Translation is near!” — Gen. 37:9, “The sun and the moon and the stars were revealing the future providence of Joseph!” — In Rey. Chap. 12, a great sign was given warning of future events and also of ominous significance! (vs. 4-5) — vs. 1, “revealed the woman was covered with the stars, sun and the moon! Each in an important position, head, body and feet! — Speaking of the Church, past, present and future! and other vital things!”

THE HEAVENS DESCRIBE THE END - St. Matt. 24:3, “And what shall be the sign of thy coming?” And greater than the magi, Jesus said, Luke 21:25, “And there shall the signs ‘literally’ in the sun and in the moon and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring! — This gives a ‘3 fold’ prophecy! It reveals the nations in stress, anguish and bewilderment!” (Back to our subject in a moment, but first this.) “The sun we know represents Japan and the kings of the east! — The moon, the ancient flag of China was represented with the moon and with the dragon on it. — Concerning the stars; the USA flag has stars; the Jewish flag has the Star of David! The Arab flag has a crescent moon and a star on it, etc. — These will all play an important role as age ends! - Other nations shown in Rev. 13:2. “Man landed on the moon is also a sign. — Nations in distress would mean there are terrible economic and famine conditions! — It states perplexity; (Without resources, in doubt, not knowing which way to turn!) It means they are looking for a strong man; the anti-Christ! — It went on to say, the seas and the waves roaring! — It reveals terrible weather conditions, for the sea has much to do with our climate! For in the Scripts it says, terrible storms, chilling weather, great winds, tornadoes and hurricanes coming! — It describes seaquakes, tidal waves! All of this Jesus stated was written in the heavens!

CONTINUING - And Jesus tells us when the major part of these events will occur! “During the times of heart failures, and when the powers of the heavens are shaken! — We know this means when the atomic bomb was exploded in 1945!” — Luke 21:29, 32, He said when Israel would be again in her homeland! — He said, And this generation that saw it would not pass away, until all things be fulfilled! — And we might add all of this will be intensified in the last 7 or 8 years of this century!” (And it most certainly did!)
